Native XNU compiles and links on the host, without handset qualification. Fixed DarwinBoot driver refusal and unload are handset-verified separately, with zero ExitBootServices. No permanent TimerArch, complete UEFI, handset kernel handoff/XNU or full RAM ownership claim.
